name.en: Move a defender to the breach

summary.zh: 固定防线顾不过来时，玩家本人就是可以移动的最后一道补丁。
summary.en: When fixed defenses cannot cover everything, the player becomes a mobile reserve.

rules.zh: 自动防御持续工作，玩家同时控制一个能移动、攻击或拦截的角色。不同入口出现危险时，玩家要决定赶往哪边，承担移动时间与离开另一条线的代价；敌人突破、设施受损和角色状态给出反馈。
rules.en: Automatic defenses keep working while the player controls a mobile character who can attack or intercept. Choose which entrance to reinforce, paying travel time and leaving another lane unsupported. Leaks, damaged structures and character state show the cost.

loop.en: Identify the lane likely to fail first
Move to the breach and intervene
Rotate elsewhere or retreat to safety

decisions.zh: 救一座快倒的塔，还是拦住已经越过塔的敌人？
decisions.en: Save a collapsing tower or intercept enemies already past it?

decisions.zh: 亲自补防节省建设费用，却把安全建立在持续操作上。
decisions.en: Personal intervention saves construction costs but makes safety depend on continued attention.

effect.zh: 速度越慢，换线越像承诺；速度快则更强调连续救火。
effect.en: Slow travel makes lane changes commitments; fast travel emphasizes frequent emergency response.

effect.zh: 角色太强会削弱布局意义；太弱则补防缺乏可感知的作用。
effect.en: An overpowering character undermines layouts; an ineffective one makes intervention feel pointless.

contrast.zh: 王权陨落更接近俯视角的换线与近身补位；幽闭圣地2还需要瞄准与射击，个人操作的内容更重。
contrast.en: Thronefall emphasizes top-down lane rotation and local intervention; Sanctum adds aiming and shooting, putting more weight on individual execution.

combination.zh: 组合提案：补防角色使用攻防共用耐力，冲刺赶路会削减到达后能挡下的攻击，让路线选择更有代价。
combination.en: Design proposal: use shared attack–defense stamina for the mobile defender; sprinting to a breach leaves less energy to block when arriving.

setup.zh: 左右两条路都有敌人，右边只剩一座残血塔。
setup.en: Both lanes are under attack, with one nearly destroyed tower on the right.

action.zh: 从左边撤出，冲到右边拦住最前面的敌人。
action.en: Leave the left lane and rush right to intercept its leading enemy.

result.zh: 右边暂时稳住，但左边的推进速度开始增加。
result.en: The right stabilizes, but enemies on the left begin advancing faster.

next.zh: 先补左边的建筑，还是继续靠自己来回跑？
next.en: Reinforce the left with a building, or keep relying on personal rotations?

firstStep.zh: 做两条短路线、自动箭塔和一个可移动攻击的圆形角色。
firstStep.en: Build two short lanes, automatic arrow towers and one movable attacking circle.

pitfall.zh: 先不加入复杂技能树；让缺口警告可读，避免玩家只能盯着两个角落。
pitfall.en: Skip elaborate skill trees; make breach warnings readable so players need not stare at two corners.

test.zh: 玩家是否能主动判断该去哪边，而不是随机奔跑碰巧救场？
test.en: Can players deliberately choose a lane to save instead of running randomly into success?
